are_you_ok.title: Weekend temperatures expected to hit 100 degrees in parts of Colorado as summer heat continues
questions: How are you managing the heat?
Do you have a way to keep cool at home?
are_you_ok.description: Colorado is heading into another dangerous stretch of summer heat, with temperatures soaring toward 100 degrees this weekend and elevated fire weather concerns across the mountains.

conversation_starters.title: Denver Water reservoir levels are below capacity. "It's a big concern," the public utility says.
conversation_starters.summary: The sources for Denver Water's supply — the utility serving Denver, about 30 miles southeast of Boulder — are taking a big hit due to the ongoing drought.
questions: Are water restrictions something you're dealing with?
Have you noticed the drought where you are?

you_should_know.title: Company that runs Aurora ICE facility could face $50,000 fines starting Wednesday
you_should_know.summary: A new state law is supposed to take effect allowing the attorney general to issue fines for denying public health access at the ICE facility in Aurora, a suburb on Denver's east side about 40 miles southeast of Boulder.
you_should_know.description: A new state law is supposed to take effect Wednesday, allowing the attorney general to issue fines for denying public health access at an ICE facility.

you_should_know.title: Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin visits Colorado, disputes tuberculosis concerns
you_should_know.summary: U.S. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin visited Colorado's Supermax prison, the federal maximum-security penitentiary at Florence in the south of the state, the U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Training Center in Colorado Springs and Immigration and Customs Enforcement offices in southern Colorado before holding a private meeting with U.S. Rep. Gabe Evans, whose district covers the suburbs and farm towns north of Denver, and Hispanic faith leaders.
